ir.name: pairwise_margin_weighted_logsigmoid_regularized_v3_repair
ir.intuition: Replace unsupported pow with mul to square scaled_margin for regularization, preserving original margin-based margin separation and stability improvements.
ir.pseudocode:
margin = log_prob_w - log_prob_l
scaled_margin_unclipped = alpha * margin - beta * delta_rank + bias
scaled_margin = clamp(scaled_margin_unclipped, -margin_clip_val, margin_clip_val)
loss_per_pair = -logsigmoid(scaled_margin)
regularizer = eps * (scaled_margin * scaled_margin)
weighted_loss = weight * (loss_per_pair + regularizer)
loss = sum(weighted_loss) / (sum(weight) + eps)
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    eps = 1e-8
    margin_clip_val = float(extra.get('margin_clip_val', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('margin_clip_val', 10.0)))
    alpha = float(extra.get('alpha', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('alpha', 1.2)))
    beta = float(extra.get('beta', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('beta', 0.1)))
    bias = float(extra.get('bias', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('bias', 0.05)))

    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    weight = batch.get('weight', ops.ones_like(lpw))
    delta_rank = batch['delta_rank']

    margin = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)
    scaled_margin_unclipped = ops.add(ops.sub(ops.mul(alpha, margin), ops.mul(beta, delta_rank)), bias)
    scaled_margin = ops.clamp(scaled_margin_unclipped, -margin_clip_val, margin_clip_val)

    loss_per_pair = ops.neg(ops.logsigmoid(scaled_margin))
    regularizer = ops.mul(eps, ops.mul(scaled_margin, scaled_margin))

    weighted_loss = ops.mul(weight, ops.add(loss_per_pair, regularizer))
    norm = ops.sum(weight) + eps
    loss = ops.div(ops.sum(weighted_loss), norm)
    return loss
